text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go! One, two! One, two!
text_block_list.name: Group of Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
The runners' chants are drowned out by
the sound
of their footsteps. Each of
them is working hard
every single day in
pursuit of their dreams.

We've set our sights on the Asahi Hai
F.S. as our
next goal, but, being a G1
race, it's tough to
even qualify.

However, given Бива Хаяхидэ's
potential, we're
not worried.

As long as she keeps gaining experience
and
improving...
Oh, you're here too.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm not one to speak. I'm here to
watch her
too. It's impossible not to get
drawn in by her
running.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
...She's always been fascinating to watch,
since
ages back.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I turn to see where she's looking.

Raaah! I'm gonna beat you today, for
sure!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Oh, be quiet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Standing on the track is Хиши Амадзон,
the
hot-blooded leader of Miho
Dormitory. She's still
awaiting her debut.

And next to her is Бива Хаяхидэ's
younger sister,
the Umamusume who's
captured everyone's
attention—Narita
Brian.

Hehe. C'mon, you can afford to loosen
up a bit.
How far are we racin', anyway?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: 1,600 meters.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
A mile, huh? That's unexpected. Any
reason for
picking that particular
distance?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Because I wanna run the whole thing full
tilt. I
crave that speed—I need to go all
out!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Planning to leave me in the dust right
from the
get-go, huh? Hah! Bring it! This
is gonna be one
helluva race!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Are you both ready? On your marks! Get
set...
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Referee

text_block_list.text: It's an amazing race.

They compete against each other with
an almost
feral ferocity. Everyone's eyes
are glued to the
intense action.
Come on, Hishiama! You can do it, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
But then, in the final stretch of the
race...
Hmph!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

Нарита Брайан unleashes a terrifying burst
of speed
that slices through the noise of
the crowd, leaving
the spectators silent.

An unsettling feeling washes over me as
I wonder
what would happen if Narita
Brian and Biwa
Hayahide were to
compete...

Even if Hayahide chased after her at full
speed,
would she ever be able to catch
up?
Тренер? Are you all right?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, if you say so. But that was quite
the intense
look you had on.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: It was the same face I made long ago...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I know how you feel. Here, let me make
use of
what I experienced before and
put your feelings
into words.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Нарита Брайан is an Umamusume worthy of one day being called the best.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Only fools would try to compete with
her in light
of her extraordinary talent.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I was that foolish once as a child. One
moment I
was running free, the next, I'd
been overtaken. I
was scared of losing,
so I panicked...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Crash!

I tried to catch up with her... and that's
when I got
hurt.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Lying in that hospital bed, I had nothing
but time
to think. And that's when—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
That's when you started working nonstop on
your winning equation, right?

text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right. And now I work on it with a strange trainer who took more interest in my potential than my sister's.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We might actually be the biggest fools
in the
whole world.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: HAYAHIDEEE!

Uh-oh. I think this is as far as our talk is
going to
get.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hello, Ticket. And you, too, Taishin.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sometimes I wish this wild child came with an off switch.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is Бива Хаяхидэ's friend
who just
debuted this year. Her slight
frame belies her
ability to run at
unimaginable speed.

You seriously need to learn to read the
room.
Couldn't you see they were
talking?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Well, I mean, I saw Hayahide, so of course I had to come and say hi!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is an energetic
Umamusume and
one of Бива Хаяхидэ's
classmates. I've heard the
three of them
are close friends.
Plus, there's something I absolutely have to say! I don't know if you realized, but all three of us...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Have made our debut! Congratulations t-to sob... everyooone! Waaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Okay, but why are you crying?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, never mind—hurry it up. Don't you
have
something else to say?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, that's right! Sorry! Okay,
since we're
all here, why don't we go on
a run?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
We can do 2,400 meters, just like that
one time!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: What time are you talking about?

text_block_list.text:
A time from ages ago. When we first
started here,
we had to measure our
times for class, and Ticket
had the idea
to run 2,400 meters for it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because the Derby is 2,400
meters long!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
(She must be talking about the Japanese
Derby...)

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can only take part in this
prestigious
race once in their lives. It's
an honor every racer
aspires to.

Normally, new students only run 1,000
meters,
but... we all just went for it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Who do you think?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The three of us! And after that, we
started doing
everything together.
Hehe, those were great
times.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's right! So Let's recreate it—just like
this!
RAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait up! Where are you going,
dummy?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Aaand they're off. Mind if I join them?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Go. And don't you dare lose!

text_block_list.text: You know I won't!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
She runs off in pursuit of Уиннинг Тикит
and
Нарита Таисин.

I wonder how much longer times like
these will
last...
The next day, I hear a rumor.

Apparently, Нарита Таисин and Winning
Ticket
will be entering the Hopeful
Stakes, a junior G1
race.

It's not the same as the Asahi Hai F.S.
that Biwa
Hayahide will be entering, but
it's still a G1... And
it's the highest junior
level race.

It would appear that Нарита Брайан isn't
the only
fierce rival out there.
